capabilities.title: Layer/resolution/tile/region selective streaming decode
capabilities.note: Bounded row-major tile and reference-region selection validate all tile-part framing and T2 headers while returning only the requested output and reconstructing only selected/intersecting tiles; single-tile streams accept the same region selector, and code blocks that cannot influence a selected region skip both T1 and payload materialization inside every decoded tile while remaining validated and covered; bounded leading quality-layer selection validates the full T2 stream while avoiding materialization and T1 decode of later bodies; bounded resolution reduction skips discarded T1 blocks and performs partial 5/3 or 9/7 synthesis. Reference-grid upsampling accepts the same selectors plus resolution reduction, and the bounded sampled sYCC conversion accepts them through a chroma-aligned window; both return the matching crop. Incremental input selection and row-oriented output remain open.
